Evaluate \(\int_{-\pi/4}^{\pi/4} \sin^2 x\,dx\).
solution: We observe that \(\sin^2 x\) is an even function. Therefore, by \(P_7\)(i), we get \(\int_{-\pi/4}^{\pi/4} \sin^2 x\,dx = 2\int_{0}^{\pi/4} \sin^2 x\,dx = 2\int_{0}^{\pi/4} \frac{1 - \cos 2x}{2}\,dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/4}(1 - \cos 2x)\,dx = \left[x - \frac{1}{2}\sin 2x\right]_{0}^{\pi/4} = \left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{1}{2}\sin \frac{\pi}{2}\right) - 0 = \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{1}{2}\).

stem: Evaluate \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x \sin x}{1 + \cos^2 x}\,dx\).
solution: Let \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x \sin x}{1 + \cos^2 x}\,dx\). Then, by \(P_4\), we have \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x)\sin(\pi - x)}{1 + \cos^2(\pi - x)}\,dx = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x)\sin x}{1 + \cos^2 x}\,dx = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{\sin x}{1 + \cos^2 x}\,dx - I\). Or \(2I = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{\sin x}{1 + \cos^2 x}\,dx\), or \(I = \frac{\pi}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{\sin x}{1 + \cos^2 x}\,dx\). Put \(\cos x = t\) so that \(-\sin x\,dx = dt\). When \(x = 0\), \(t = 1\) and when \(x = \pi\), \(t = -1\). Therefore, (by \(P_1\)) we get \(I = \frac{-\pi}{2}\int_{1}^{-1} \frac{dt}{1 + t^2} = \frac{\pi}{2}\int_{-1}^{1} \frac{dt}{1 + t^2} = \pi\int_{0}^{1} \frac{dt}{1 + t^2}\) (by \(P_7\), since \(\frac{1}{1+t^2}\) is even function) \(= \pi\left[\tan^{-1} t\right]_{0}^{1} = \pi\left[\tan^{-1} 1 - \tan^{-1} 0\right] = \pi\left[\frac{\pi}{4} - 0\right] = \frac{\pi^2}{4}\).

stem: Evaluate \(\int_{-1}^{1} \sin^5 x \cos^4 x\,dx\).
solution: Let \(I = \int_{-1}^{1} \sin^5 x \cos^4 x\,dx\). Let \(f(x) = \sin^5 x \cos^4 x\). Then \(f(-x) = \sin^5(-x)\cos^4(-x) = -\sin^5 x \cos^4 x = -f(x)\), i.e., \(f\) is an odd function. Therefore, by \(P_7\)(ii), \(I = 0\).

stem: Evaluate \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sin^4 x}{\sin^4 x + \cos^4 x}\,dx\).
solution: Let \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sin^4 x}{\sin^4 x + \cos^4 x}\,dx\) ... (1). Then, by \(P_4\), \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sin^4\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right)}{\sin^4\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right) + \cos^4\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right)}\,dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\cos^4 x}{\cos^4 x + \sin^4 x}\,dx\) ... (2). Adding (1) and (2), we get \(2I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sin^4 x + \cos^4 x}{\sin^4 x + \cos^4 x}\,dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} dx = [x]_{0}^{\pi/2} = \frac{\pi}{2}\). Hence \(I = \frac{\pi}{4}\).

stem: Evaluate \(\int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} \frac{dx}{1 + \sqrt{\tan x}}\).
solution: Let \(I = \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} \frac{dx}{1 + \sqrt{\tan x}} = \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} \frac{\sqrt{\cos x}\,dx}{\sqrt{\cos x} + \sqrt{\sin x}}\) ... (1). Then, by \(P_3\) (with \(a + b = \frac{\pi}{6} + \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{\pi}{2}\)), \(I = \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} \frac{\sqrt{\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{3} + \frac{\pi}{6} - x\right)}}{\sqrt{\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{3} + \frac{\pi}{6} - x\right)} + \sqrt{\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{3} + \frac{\pi}{6} - x\right)}}\,dx = \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} \frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\sin x} + \sqrt{\cos x}}\,dx\) ... (2). Adding (1) and (2), we get \(2I = \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} dx = [x]_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} = \frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{6}\). Hence \(I = \frac{\pi}{12}\).

stem: Evaluate \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx\).
solution: Let \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx\). Then, by \(P_4\), \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \log \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right)\,dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \log \cos x\,dx\). Adding the two values of I, we get \(2I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2}(\log \sin x + \log \cos x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/2}(\log \sin x \cos x + \log 2 - \log 2)\,dx\) (by adding and subtracting \(\log 2\)) \(= \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x\,dx - \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \log 2\,dx\). Put \(2x = t\) in the first integral. Then \(2\,dx = dt\), when \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) and when \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t = \pi\). Therefore \(2I = \frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi} \log \sin t\,dt - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2 = \frac{2}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \log \sin t\,dt - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\) (by \(P_6\) as \(\sin(\pi - t) = \sin t\)) \(= \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\) (by changing variable \(t\) to \(x\)) \(= I - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\). Hence \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx = \frac{-\pi}{2}\log 2\).
